summary: This note describes Mr. Noodle and his siblings, characters who appear in the Elmo's World segments of the children's television program Sesame Street. Mr. Noodle was played by Broadway actor Bill Irwin, who had earlier worked with Arlene Sherman on short films for the program.
one_line: Mr. Noodle and his siblings are characters in the Elmo's World segments of Sesame Street, with Mr. Noodle played by Bill Irwin.
key_facts: Mr. Noodle and his siblings appear in the Elmo's World segments of the educational children's television program Sesame Street.
Mr. Noodle's siblings are Mister Noodle, Ms Noodle, and Miss Noodle.
Mr. Noodle was played by Broadway actor Bill Irwin.
Bill Irwin had previously worked with Arlene Sherman in short films for Sesame Street.
Arlene Sherman is the executive producer of Sesame Street.
Arlene Sherman is a co-creator of Elmo's World.
